title: Sterling Breeze #506 and #604
meta_description: Two beachfront condos at Sterling Breeze with Gulf views, balconies, BBQs, pool, hot tub \& direct beach access.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Sterling Breeze #506 \& #604 by AvantStay! These two beachfront condos sit within the same resort complex on the sugar-white sands of Panama City Beach, offering a combined 5 bedrooms and 6 bathrooms that comfortably sleep up to 14 guests. Perfect for family reunions, multi-family trips, or groups of friends, this buyout option allows everyone to stay close while still enjoying the privacy of two separate units.

As part of the Sterling Breeze community, you'll enjoy shared resort amenities including a beachfront pool overlooking the Gulf, a hot tub, a fitness and recreation center, and even a convenient on-site store for last-minute essentials. A private boardwalk puts you right on the sand in moments, while Pier Park's shopping, dining, and entertainment are less than a mile away.

Sterling Breeze #506 features two bedrooms and three bathrooms, with sleeping space for up to 8 guests. The primary suite offers a king bed and ensuite bath, while the second suite includes a queen bed with its own bathroom. A twin bunk nook and a living room sleeper sofa provide extra flexibility. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame the Gulf, and a private balcony with a built-in BBQ makes dining with an ocean view effortless.

Sterling Breeze #604 offers three bedrooms and three bathrooms, sleeping up to 6 guests. Two ensuite bedrooms---one with a king bed and one with a double---create comfortable retreats, while the bunk room is perfect for kids. Like #506, the private balcony includes a BBQ grill, making it easy to pair meals with fresh sea air. The bright, open-concept living space and fully equipped kitchen invite relaxed gatherings at any time of day.

With unmatched Gulf views, resort-style amenities, and two fully equipped condos side by side, Sterling Breeze #506 \& #604 is the ultimate group-friendly getaway on Panama City Beach.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach.

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- A Pack 'n Play is available upon request.

Parking Details:
- Paid parking is available at $50, with a maximum of 2 garage spots. Parking is on a first-come, first-served basis.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
